title: Know Before Employees Do: Introducing Proactive Admin Alerts
summary: Clear alerts and next steps help your HR teams address data, funding, and contribution issues before they affect employees.
body_markdown:
Flexible benefits administration depends on what happens behind the scenes. Employee data, elections, contributions, funding balances, payroll files, HRIS updates, and bank transfers all need to flow accurately between systems.


Critical trends and operational issues are often discovered only after employees are affected, forcing HR teams to investigate the root cause of each benefits issue instead of focusing on strategic work.


Benepass Administrator (Admin) Alerts change that experience with clear notifications, contextual explanations, and recommended next steps. Instead of relying on clunky reports, vague emails, or support teams to explain what happened, admins can see what requires attention and understand how to respond.


## Clean Data Keeps Benefits Moving


Data discrepancies are an unavoidable part of managing complex HR systems. In its[HR Processing Risk and Cost Survey](https://eyquest.com/files/Cost_and_Risks_Due_to_Payroll_Errors_2022_Final.pdf) , EY found that benefit errors occurred at a rate of 503 per 1,000 employees, with each error costing an average of $291 to resolve directly and indirectly.


Benepass is designed to reduce the manual work that creates these issues. Today, 81% of employer integrations run fully automatically within the platform. HRIS, BenAdmin, and payroll data flows into Benepass through APIs or scheduled file feeds with zero manual intervention. More than 15 million employee record changes have already flowed automatically into Benepass from employer systems.


But as more benefits administration happens on autopilot, admins need visibility into the exceptions that require their attention. Admin Alerts provide that additional layer, flagging potential issues and providing the context they need to investigate further before employees are affected.


## From Reactive To Proactive Notifications


At launch, you’ll be able to review over 10 alert types across five key areas, with more alerts coming over time:


- **File Feed Errors** : Overdue files or significant increases in sync errors
- **Funding Issues** : Low balances, failed transfers, canceled transfers, or returned payments
- **Employee Data Issues** : Missing active employees or duplicate identity records
- **Contribution Issues** : HSA contributions or reversals that couldn't be completed
- **Security Alerts** : Potentially duplicated Social Security numbers


HR leaders can click any alert to drill down into its details and metadata, and then access tailored Help Center articles for additional context and resolution guidance.


## See Three Alerts In Action


Imagine getting an alert email that **your latest payroll file is missing several active employees using Benepass,** followed by a message from your Customer Success Manager. A downloadable CSV shows exactly who’s affected, helping you catch data mismatches or identify terminated employees who still have benefit access before they accidentally spend funds they shouldn’t.


Or consider that after a company merger, **the latest employee data sync produces at least 30% more errors.** Newly added employees arrive on the file feed with missing, required data. A homepage callout in Benepass indicates you need to take action. It displays counts and trends by alert type, drills down into individual alerts and metadata, and uses AI to receive per-alert analysis and resolution guidance. With added context, it’s straightforward to correct and resend the file before these data quality issues affect employee eligibility or elections.


In another scenario, a **scheduled HSA contribution cannot be completed because platform funding balance is too low.** The alert explains why the contribution failed and what needs to happen next, giving ample opportunity to add funds before delayed contributions confuse your employees.


## Clear Alerts, Guided Next Steps


Admin Alerts create a coordinated communication path for identifying and correcting issues. Benefit leaders can view recent alerts from a callout on the Benepass homepage, or open the centralized alerts dashboard to see counts, trends, timestamps, metadata, and affected records.


Weekly alert emails bring new issues to their attention. The dashboard summaries explain what happened and why it’s important. Downloadable files support investigation, while linked[Help Center articles](https://support.getbenepass.com/en/articles/16764034-understanding-and-resolving-benepass-alerts) provide detailed resolution guidance.


The result is greater operational confidence as you can:


- Identify issues before employees report them
- Investigate problems without searching across systems
- Resolve funding and data issues faster
- Strengthen data quality over time


Benefits administration shouldn't mean waiting for problems to find you. With Admin Alerts, you'll catch and resolve issues before your employees know there’s anything to fix.
